name: bubble-sort
stdin:
.equ N, 8
.data
arr:    .space N
.text
main:   mov r0, 0
rd:     in r1
        mov [arr+r0], r1
        inc r0
        cmp r0, N
        jl rd
outer:  mov r2, 0
        mov r3, 0
inner:  mov r4, [arr+r3]
        lea r5, [r3+1]
        mov r6, [arr+r5]
        cmp r4, r6
        jle noswap
        mov [arr+r3], r6
        mov [arr+r5], r4
        mov r2, 1
noswap: inc r3
        cmp r3, N-1
        jl inner
        cmp r2, 0
        jne outer
        mov r0, 0
pr:     mov r1, [arr+r0]
        out r1
        inc r0
        cmp r0, N
        jl pr
        halt

name: sieve
stdin:
.equ LIMIT, 50
.data
flags:  .space LIMIT+1, 1
.text
main:   mov r0, 2
outer:  mov r1, r0
        mul r1, r0
        cmp r1, LIMIT
        jg report
        mov r2, [flags+r0]
        cmp r2, 0
        je nexto
inner:  cmp r1, LIMIT
        jg nexto
        mov r3, 0
        mov [flags+r1], r3
        add r1, r0
        jmp inner
nexto:  inc r0
        jmp outer
report: mov r0, 2
rl:     cmp r0, LIMIT
        jg fin
        mov r2, [flags+r0]
        cmp r2, 0
        je skip
        out r0
skip:   inc r0
        jmp rl
fin:    halt
